sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the 
 equipment inspection I1, which must be
 performed on a weekly intervals bases 
 as indicated by 
 W1 in the title block.

The aim of these instructions is to recommend a minimum 
 requirements for checks and inspections in order to maintain the reliability 
 of the fire fighting systems in the transformer yards.

The 
first draft initiated by Eng. Emad Farouq Moustafa at Katamia 220kv substation Cairo Zone.
Safety Precautions

items: A work permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,

Transformer outage is 
 required

After the functioning 
 test of the system, make sure

That the value between 
 compressor and main tank is closed before refilling the tank again with water

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Safety Helmet, Safety Shoes, and breathing mask .

sections.text: Work to be carried out
Readiness for Operation

The main gate valve (B1) and the main gate valves controlling the water supply, 
e.g. (B2), must be secured open by a pad - locked up.

The alarm test cock (G) must be in " service" position the drain valve (E1) and 
the vent valve (E2) must be closed
The air filling valve (M) must be open
The handles of the pressure gauge control cocks must be directed down wards

Thoroughly inspect the pilot hands (0) and the extinguishing nozzles (P) 
periodically and remove dust, fibers, paint, etc., if necessary

It is not allowed to hang or lay any thing from or on the nozzle pipes and 
incitation lines

sections.text: Maintenance of the Extinguishing system

Check the air pressure at the pressure gauge (K1) the pressure in the incitation 
pipe system shall be 6 bar and must not drop below 5 bar
Check the pressure of the water supply, e.g. at pressure gauge (K2)

Check the pressure of the water volume and air pressure of tank and / or the 
water volume of the elevated tank

Check the pressure gauges (K1) & (K2) by closing thier control cocks and 
loosening the lateral knurled head screws. 
The indicators must go back to zero, 
At the same time, the air pressure supervising switch (L) is relived and the 
electric air leakage detection checked

Test of fire alarm. Set alarm test cock to "test" until an alarm is sounding; 
then set alarm test cock again to "service"
Check the pump for operation

sections.text: In case of a fire
After release of only one incitation nozzle. Manual release of the value by:
Electric remote operation of the solenoid valve
Operating of the manual release lever at the solenoid valve
Operating hand incitation valves in the incitation piping

items: Electric remote operation of the solenoid valve
Operating of the manual release lever at the solenoid valve
Operating hand incitation valves in the incitation piping

sections.text: Stopping of the Alarm
Set alarm test cock (G) to "closed" position
After a fire

After extinction of the fire, close main gate valve (B1) and air filling valve 
(M)

Drain the valve (C) and the nozzle piping by opening the drain valve (E1) and 
all the drain values of the nozzle piping

Replace the opened incitation nozzles by new ones from the spare stock 
(Attention refill the spare stock)

Re establish the readiness for operation of the single - chamber remote control 
station Attention lever indicates the switch position.
